product_decision.pdf: exactly one property per Letter page with no cover, agenda, overview, or broker-conclusion page
product_decision.web: responsive confidential list-first share page with the same immutable stop order
product_decision.map: secondary orientation surface that never replaces the ordered list

rules: Use navy for structure and orange only for focus, calls to action, and small accents.
Preserve generous white space, a fixed hierarchy, and a consistent fact grid.
Keep Stop 1, Stop 2, and subsequent route order visible across every surface.
Use one reviewed property image when a rights-cleared immutable asset exists; remain polished without one.
Express reaction state with words and control state, never color alone.

pdf_acceptance: Author directly for US Letter with a fixed safe live area.
Pin template, renderer, font, asset, projection, and QC-rule digests.
Require one public property reference and one unique route marker per page.
Block page-count, order, marker, clipping, font, asset, link, component-digest, or R2-readback mismatch.
A clean automated QC result remains review_required; human review is separate from publication.
responsive_acceptance: Use semantic headings and ordered lists, visible keyboard focus, labels, text status feedback, and single-column reflow.
Require explicit user action before exchanging the fragment bearer for a host-only session cookie.
Persist latest reaction state and bind every note and reaction to an opaque public property reference.
Verify PDF response bytes against the immutable SHA-256 artifact digest before delivery.

primary_sources.title: Adobe print scaling and page sizing

anecdotal_interpretation: The Reddit signal supports paired print and responsive delivery but cannot override CARR facts-only, page-count, rights, confidentiality, accessibility, or human-publication rules.
